label: Bible Study
prompt: And he is the _____ of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verse: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
note: Christ is head of the body, the church — first in creation and first from the dead.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the _____ of the world.
verse: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
note: John the Baptist sees Jesus coming and introduces Him with one picture: the Lamb of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the _____ that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
verse: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
note: John received his Revelation in exile on the isle called Patmos, 'for the word of God.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For a just man falleth _____ times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verse: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
note: The righteous fall too — the difference is they keep getting back up.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye _____ ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verse: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
note: Don't add, don't 'diminish' — Moses' rule for God's word, echoed in the Bible's closing warning (Revelation 22:18–19).
